description: Nomenclátor de calles de Palafrugell is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by palafrugell.cat. Palafrugell StreetNomeclator contains a list of all the names of the streets of the municipality alphabetically. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Palafrugell street nomenclator" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Nomenclàtor, Palafrugell, Nomenclator, Carrerer, Callejero, Nomenclátor. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
